authorization_boundary: Public-source observation and simulation only. No orders, brokerage authentication, recurring jobs, paid services or capital authorization.
registration_context: Registered after H21 historical exposure, before any target-period quote. Git commit timestamp is the authoritative registration time.
hypothesis: Keep the same broad-equity investment mechanism; observe future costs, event completeness, money outcomes and market risk without retuning the historical result.
entry: First B3 trading session on or after 2026-09-10, fixed before seeing that session's quotes. Public daily COTAHIST acquisition can occur after publication; acquisition time is not the investment signal.
exit: First B3 trading session on or after 2027-09-10. No exit chosen from returns; missing data remain blocked, not a favorable date substitution.
position: Same largest affordable multiple-of-ten convention as historical H21, even though current market minimum is one unit. This preserves the tested rule; any change to one-unit sizing requires a separate prospective version before that version's data. No leverage, contributions or alternative ETF selection.
source_obligations: Save original B3 daily/annual quote publications and SHA256; confirm identity, quote factor, scheduled market sessions and settlement calendar.

Preserve ETF announcements and versions as published. Reconcile ex/right/payment/amortization/split or liquidation events and post-sale obligations; no declaration of zero events merely from absent jumps.
Acquire actual public brokerage/B3 tariff terms when an operational scenario is specified, preserving availability and effective dates. Keep modeled rates separately.
Maintain simulated positions, cash, unsettled receivables, cost basis and total tax reserve; no reuse of unsettled cash.
Timestamp source collection and any manual review; never label model/agent review human or independent.
planned_checkpoints: First 20 B3 sessions: mechanics, source completeness and cost feasibility only, no parameter selection from P&L. At the fixed one-year endpoint: all four specifications/eight valuations, accumulated BRL profit, costs, drawdown and matched dates. One year is one dependent observation, not proof of a persistent risk premium or individual suitability.
comparison: Nominal initial capital and a separately labeled gross BCB Selic reference. H20 incremental benefit remains unmeasured unless a separately registered comparable book is available.
unknowns: Personal capital, loss tolerance, horizon, fixed charges, construction and maintenance effort remain unknown. No zero-default or income forecast.
stopping: At each bounded manual checkpoint, stop on complete report or demonstrated missing inputs. No switch of ETF, cost/price variant or endpoint to recover losses. No automatic GO from a favorable snapshot.
trial_accounting: Zero forward observations have occurred. This document adds no historical performance evaluation and does not supply independent evidence by itself.
next_manual_action: After the first scheduled session's data become public, capture its source and an ETF-event baseline into a new dated directory; record actual publication/retrieval times. Do not claim a live position or an operating monitor.
